result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example. The tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` and `*SalesRep*` ran clean, and the full suite wasn't run.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, which is the same filter the other per-rep counts use. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are excluded.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0, and the ordering (highest count first) is unchanged.
